table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	InvoiceCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	HeaderInvCode=S.HeaderInvNo,
	HeaderNo=S.HeaderNo,
	Date=Date,
	Customer=A.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	Address= RTRIM(LTRIM(C.Address1)) + ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(C.Address2)),
	City=C.CITY, 
	Country=C.Country,
	NetAmt=InvTotal,
	ReceivedOnInv=isnull(S.Amt, 0) + isnull(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode), 0),
	Debits=ISNULL((SELECT debit=SUM(debit) FROM GLdetail D, GLHeader H 
			WHERE  H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
					D.InvoiceCode = S.SaleInvCode AND 
					H.VochCatCode IN (SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
					WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=1)),0),
	OtherReceipts=ISNULL((SELECT credit=SUM(credit) FROM GLdetail D, GLHeader H 
			WHERE  H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
					D.InvoiceCode = S.SaleInvCode AND 
					H.VochCatCode IN (SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
					WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=1)),0),
	ChequesReceived=ISNULL((SELECT Amt=SUM(D.Amt) FROM Notesdetail D, Notes H 
			WHERE  D.InvoiceCode = S.SaleInvCode AND H.NoteCatCode=1 AND H.NoteCode = D.NoteCode), 0),
	AllocatedReturns=ISNULL((SELECT Amt=SUM(D.Amt) FROM SRAllocationdetail D, SRAllocationHeader H 
			WHERE  D.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode AND H.SRAllocationCode = D.SRAllocationCode), 0),
	CashOnInvBalance=S.InvTotal - (isnull(S.Amt, 0) + isnull(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode), 0)),
	Balance=OutstandingAmt,
	Posted=S.Posted,
	AccountFor=S.AccountFor,
	RefNo=S.CustRefNo,
	SalePerson = (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE S.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode),
	AmtReceivedBy = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = S.AmtBy)
FROM 
	SaleLedger S, Accounts A, Customer C
WHERE
/*	S.Posted = 'Y' AND*/
	S.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	S.Marked = 'N' AND
	S.Date >= :ad_startdate AND S.DATE <= :ad_enddate AND
	S.SaleCatCode IN (2) AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.AccCode = C.CustCode
ORDER BY
	SaleInvCode,
	Date
